thesis: Gorilla Shaman turns spare mana into repeatable artifact destruction and became “Mox Monkey” because zero-mana artifacts are the cheapest possible targets.

competitiveTimeline.significance: The Shaman became a Vintage and Eternal sideboard icon whose nickname captures its specialized role in punishing the game’s most efficient mana.

playbook.role: Deploy it early against artifact mana, destroy the lowest-cost pieces first, and leave enough mana to threaten multiple activations. Its value drops sharply against expensive nonartifact boards.
